fields.statement: How should an accept made in the main clone (Inbox app or rhiza accept) reach the ship-change run's branch? Today the run's worktree copies a change set's main-clone log entries only when the worktree lacks the change set entirely, so a committed proposed change set never gets its untracked accept entry. / This change set serves no intent yet. Which should it serve? Earlier daemon fixes (zombie drivers, owner-run gate accept, driver CPU) serve milestone-25 (backlog emptied by the daemon on its own); Inbox app fixes served m26-inbox-app.
